candidate.description: Only lane 0 issues each wave-uniform scale/min load and broadcasts the uint32 word with wave shuffle; Q payload, d/dmin, dequantization, FMA, reductions, fused SiLU, layout, launch geometry, and residency are unchanged.

decision.reason: Wave divergence plus eight metadata broadcasts per K ownership step cost far more than the coalescer-served replicated loads. The candidate is decisively negative at the actual-weight leaf and was removed completely.
